title: Gated adoption playbook for Optimize suggestions (PulseGate controlled)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a PulseGate-controlled gated rollout and approval playbook for automatically applying Optimize recommendations (batching and caching configs). The system must safely progress canaries, surface deterministic approval prompts, detect QoE and latency regressions, and execute deterministic rollback when thresholds are breached. This ticket focuses on the control-plane policies, canary cohort definitions, evaluation signals, approval integrations (Console + Slack), and the documented runbook for SRE/SE teams.
acceptance_criteria: PulseGate can be configured per-customer with a canary cohort progression schedule and explicit approval steps
Automatic application of batching/caching suggestions is gated; no full-customer apply without at least one successful canary stage and explicit approval when required
System evaluates both perf metrics (p50/p95 latency, token throughput, error rate) and quality regressions (prompt-set eval delta, sample perplexity/semantic similarity) during canaries
Rollback triggers execute within 60s of threshold crossing and revert config to exact prior state; incident trace links created automatically
Approval flow surfaces impact estimates and links to evaluation artifacts in Console and posts actionable messages to configured Slack channels
rollout_steps: Stage 0: Dry-run — apply suggestion to a shadow path (no traffic) for 24h; collect compile-time and cache warming metrics
Stage 1: Micro-canary — 0.5% traffic by token-weighted sampling, cohort defined by customer route and short-sequence priority, run 2 hours
Stage 2: Small-canary — 5% traffic, length-bucket coverage (short, med), run 4 hours
Stage 3: Broad-canary — 25% traffic, include long-sequence bucket and KV-cache heavy routes, run 6 hours
Stage 4: Staged-apply with soft-fallback — 100% traffic but with automatic graceful fallback to previous config on per-request basis if per-request latency > threshold
Approval gate: If quality signals degrade beyond configured tolerance at any stage, require manual approval from PM + SRE to proceed
monitoring_signals: Latency: p50, p95, p99 token generation latencies per route
Errors: 5xx rates and per-request error codes
Cache: KV-cache hit ratio and prefix cache hit latency
Quality: eval prompt-set delta (ROUGE/semantic-similarity), sample perplexity distribution, hallucination indicators
Cost: estimated token-cost delta and projected monthly delta for customer
automated_triggers: Auto-rollback if p95 latency increases > 30% for two consecutive evaluation windows (10m each)
Auto-rollback if error rate increases > 0.5 percentage points and absolute error rate > 1%
Pause progression if eval prompt-set quality delta > configured tolerance (default: 1.5% ROUGE drop or 0.03 semantic-similarity loss)
Escalate to manual approval if KV-cache hit ratio decreases by > 15% causing cost to increase beyond projected savings
Auto-notify owners and open a Console incident with attached sample traces on any rollback
